title: terraform: refactor private GPU node pools + IAM/networking state layout
author: Avery Chen
description: Motivation: simplify and stabilize terraform state layout for Private deployments with GPUs to improve upgrade/rollback behavior and make IAM/networking resources clearer for multi-cluster installs. This refactor flattens node pool state, extracts IAM roles into a dedicated module with stable resource addresses, and normalizes networking resources to avoid accidental drift during upgrade. Includes migration plan and compatibility shims so existing installs can migrate state without data loss. Checklist: 1) extract iam module and update references 2) introduce node_pool module with normalized naming and meta attributes 3) move subnetwork / route tables into networking module with stable resource addresses 4) add a state migration terraform plan + script 5) add E2E upgrade test harness and doc updates 6) CI integration for terratest and fmt/lint. Testing: unit tests for modules, terratest upgrade scenario (v1 -> refactor), manual smoke on internal QA cluster with 2 x A100 pools, and CI runs on PR validating init/plan/apply/destroy in a sandbox GCP project. Rollout: This PR adds a migration tool (scripts/terraform/migrate_state.sh) that generates a terraform state mv plan and verification checklist. Operators should run the migration in a maintenance window and follow the doc in terraform/PRIVATE_UPGRADE.md. Backwards compatibility: includes compatibility layer that keeps old resource names as read-only aliases for one release cycle. Risk: medium (state moves) but mitigated by the migration script and a fallback rehydrate plan.

release_notes: Refactor terraform state layout for Private GPU deployments: Introduces modules for node pools, IAM, and networking; adds a migration script and upgrade guide. Operators must run terraform/scripts/terraform/migrate_state.sh and follow PRIVATE_UPGRADE.md to move to the new layout. This change improves upgrade/rollback reliability and prepares ground for multi-cluster private installs.
notes_for_ops: Run migrate_state.sh in a maintenance window. The script supports --dry-run and outputs a checklist. Keep backups of state before migration (gs://redwood-terraform-state-backups). If rollback needed, use terraform state push with the backup and follow the rehydrate steps in PRIVATE_UPGRADE.md.
risk_and_mitigation: Risk: state move and IAM renames may cause transient auth issues. Mitigation: dry-run mode, pre/post IAM-binding verification hashes, compatibility alias resources for one release, and canary rollout to one customer followed by gradual rollout.
notes: This PR consolidates a long-standing set of tech-debt changes requested by SRE and Private install teams. Coordinate with customer success before wide rollout.
